stem: A facility changes to a new batch of nominally similar media and immediately sees a different dryback pattern under the same irrigation schedule. What is the strongest response?
choices: Assume the new media behaves the same because matching product names indicate equivalent water retention and drainage properties
Increase nutrient concentration until dryback resembles the previous batch, using EC adjustment to compensate for the media difference
Characterize the new media's actual water-holding and drainage behavior and adjust irrigation from measured performance
Keep the previous schedule through harvest because changing irrigation after a media batch change creates more variability than it solves
rationale: Media with similar labels can differ in physical behavior. Actual water retention, drainage, and crop response should be measured before assuming the previous irrigation schedule remains appropriate.
